prose.subject: URGENT: Change of NEAR Payout Account - INV-66064
prose.body:
Hi Lena,

Hope your week is going well. As discussed with our finance team, we are transitioning our primary NEAR wallet infrastructure to a new corporate vault to streamline settlement times for Q3.

Please note that for all upcoming payments, including the pending invoice INV-66064 for 5728.23 USDC, the funds must be sent to our new verified NEAR account: upwellfaciities53.testnet

This change is effective immediately to ensure your payment does not bounce back to our old address. We have attached the updated wire instructions and the public address checksum for your records. 

Given the timing, could you please prioritize processing this transfer today? Our accounts payable system is already flagged for this specific invoice, and we want to avoid any reconciliation delays on our end. 

If you have any questions, just reply here. I am available on call if you need to verify the address hash directly.

Best regards,

Lena Rossi
Senior Financial Coordinator
Upwell Facilities
